end.summary:
Discussed why sharing household work helps families care for one another.
Trisha gave examples of bringing water and giving Papa the remote.
They practised identifying small jobs children can do, including watering plants.
Trisha gave two unaided correct responses about household work.
end.parentNote: Asha practised shared household work through family examples and choosing small jobs for different family members. Trisha correctly identified that Arjun can water plants and later said children can do small jobs; the earlier mix-up about children not helping was partly corrected later in the lesson. At home, invite Trisha to choose one small household task and talk about how it helps the family.
